title: The two-primary BSD formula at low two-Selmer corank
exact_target: For every elliptic curve E over Q with full 2-power Selmer $Z_2-corank$ at most one, must analytic and Mordell-Weil ranks agree, must whole Sha be finite, and must the BSD-normalized leading L-value be a positive rational number whose 2-adic valuation equals that of the Sha order? No rational two-torsion or reduction-type hypothesis is imposed.
